blockingIssues.problem: Asserts the board approved repeating the check because the results convinced it the scanner improves researcher access.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: The source reports only that “The board approved checking the same two batches again after three months; it deferred purchasing more scanners.” and also that “The minutes give no reason for that vote and report no effect on researcher access.”
blockingIssues.constraint: The source does not provide a reason for the board’s vote and does not support attributing that the board believed the scanner improves researcher access.
